scope: raw unrectified pixel correspondences; per-pixel inverse distortion; feature ratio test + rectified RANSAC + vertical consistency
coordinate_convention: camera x=right, y=down, z=forward; common stereo frame is left camera; water ray origin is outer glass/water interface

evidence_checked: git history (two commits; no calibration provenance commit)

native_pinhole_model.depth_definition: Z_left_camera from raw SDK calibration and closest-point triangulation
native_pinhole_model.transform_convention: SDK raw stereo_transform interpreted as right-camera-to-left-camera because X_left=R X_right+T

custom_pinhole_model.depth_definition: Z_left_camera from raw custom K/D and closest-point triangulation
custom_pinhole_model.transform_convention: custom YAML R/T interpreted as OpenCV left-to-right; refractive common-frame transform is its inverse

notes: native_depth and custom_depth are raw-pixel pinhole triangulation comparisons, not independent GT
refractive_depth remains null unless all port parameters are supplied with provenance=measured
ordinary rectified SGBM disparity is not used as a general refractive triangulation input
